title: Fourier decay and non-decay for pseudo-affine self-conformal measures
summary: We study the sharpness of recent sufficient conditions for polynomial Fourier decay of self conformal measures on the line. First, we construct a $C^\infty$ iterated function system which is not $C^1$-conjugate to self-similar, but which nevertheless admits a stationary measure that is not Rajchman. Second, for every strongly separated Bernoulli convolution $μ$ and every $1\leq r<\infty$, we construct a $C^r$-diffeomorphism $h$ such that $h'$ is constant on $\operatorname{supp}μ$, yet the image measure $hμ$ has polynomial Fourier decay.
